business_problem: Intesa Sanpaolo won’t be intimidated by a constantly evolving threat landscape. It needed a tool set that could help it brace against increasing malicious actors, growing legal and regulatory requirements, and the scarcity of cybersecurity talent.
solution_summary: Intesa Sanpaolo won’t be intimidated by a constantly evolving threat landscape. It needed a tool set that could help it brace against increasing malicious actors, growing legal and regulatory requirements, and the scarcity of cybersecurity talent. The bank deployed the Microsoft Sentinel security information and event management system to scale elastically to evolving security needs and simplify threat detection. It supports its threat hunters with Microsoft Copilot for Security. Intesa identifies and mitigates previously unknown threats faster and more effectively, thanks to AI-enabled Microsoft Sentinel. New security staff reach peak effectiveness faster with productivity-enhancing Microsoft Copilot for Security.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Sentinel
solution_components.role: Serves as the SIEM layer that collects telemetry and supports threat detection, investigation, and response.

solution_components.name: Microsoft Copilot for Security
solution_components.role: Turns security telemetry into incident summaries, queries, reports, and recommended response steps.

business_outcome: Despite an ever more complex and changing cybersecurity landscape, Intesa remains proactive with a tool set fed by constant innovation. Thanks to comprehensive threat intelligence from Microsoft and the flexibility of Microsoft Sentinel in ingesting multiple threat intelligence feeds, the bank can quickly identify and mitigate previously unknown threats while also prioritizing them appropriately.
architecture_clues: Security telemetry and threat-intelligence feeds are ingested into Microsoft Sentinel, where Copilot for Security helps analysts generate KQL queries, summarize findings, and produce executive reports from the live SIEM context.
